title: Canada’s Carney on Capital Investment, AI, US Trade
description:
Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney talks about efforts to increase foreign investment in the nation, seeking coordination on artificial intelligence safety, and the state of trade with the United States. He joins Bloomberg News' Ottawa Bureau Chief Brian Platt ahead of the country's first national investment summit in Toronto.
